summary.headline: Configurations and Planetary Strength
summary.text: Astrological judgments about the Moon decanating Mercury and the relative strength of sextiles, trines, planetary co-presences, and other configurations in angular and succedent places and the Lot of Fortune. A note identifies the passage as closely copied from Vettius Valens and records variant readings from codex 334.
